To summarise, in the ﬁrst case the heterotic description of the CHL model is self-
dual under the Fricke S-duality, while the corresponding type IIA description is self-dual
under Fricke T-duality (see Figure 1), i.e. relates diﬀerent points in the same connected
component of the moduli space. In the second and third case we have webs of dualities with
4 corners. In case 2, Fricke S-duality maps a strongly coupled CHL model to the weakly
coupled limit of a diﬀerent CHL model (see Figure 2), i.e. relates two diﬀerent components
of the moduli space. In case 3, on the other hand, the weakly coupled description of the
heterotic CHL model is instead given in terms of a genuinely diﬀerent theory, namely a
type IIA torus orbifold of (4, 0)-type (see Figure 3).
